items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: That's where Jules Paduca was at the Silver Slipper. Yeah, he was down there too. But I wasn't with him there.

ctx.x: And I was one of his parmars. I was one of his parmars. What about Ferdinand Trombino?

That's, that's another story. I never will forget Joe Loi Canna playing saxophone on there. And he comes in there and if you saw, he had one leg. And if Joe wouldn't cross the river for nothing in a well, he wasn't going to cross the river. If you had a job on there to give a damn it for what it was, he wasn't going to cross it. And then we go to work at the Silver Slipper down at the... That's what I was trying to remember. That's where Jules Paduca was at the Silver Slipper. Yeah, he was down there too. But I…
Yeah, you told us about him last night. LeBlanc, Judge LeBlanc? No, no.
